recognize_zh: 高倍（100x）PAS 染色下，大型細胞有豐富的淡粉紅色細胞質，可見平行的纖維狀條紋（像皺褶的絲綢），核小而偏心、染色質溫和，這就是 Gaucher 細胞；周圍的小圓形深藍核為殘存造血細胞。
features: Large polygonal cells with abundant pale pink PAS-positive cytoplasm showing fine parallel fibrillary striations
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with bland chromatin and small nucleoli
Occasional cells with clear cytoplasmic spaces or retraction artifact
Cells arranged in a cohesive-appearing sheet with distinct cell borders
Admixed small hematopoietic cells with dark round nuclei
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow trephine section stained with PAS shows sheets of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale pink PAS-positive cytoplasm containing fine parallel fibrillary striations and small eccentric bland nuclei. Residual small hematopoietic cells are interspersed. No hemophagocytosis, organisms or nuclear atypia is identified. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells, whose cytoplasmic glucocerebroside accumulation is PAS positive and diastase resistant.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells have similar striated PAS-positive cytoplasm and are distinguished by the associated CML, myeloma or thalassemia and normal enzyme activity.
MAC histiocytes have striated-appearing cytoplasm but contain numerous acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells show evenly vacuolated foamy cytoplasm with weaker PAS staining rather than fibrillary striations.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic immunoglobulin crystals and associate with a clonal plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm with light chain restriction.
